verdict.rationale: Pinecone docs mention creating backups of serverless indexes to protect/copy data (docs-12/20), which is loosely related to bulk export/import, but the evidence pack never documents a dedicated bulk-import (e.g., from object storage) or bulk-export API with a specified vector+metadata file format. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-import API/CLI docs, documented export file format (e.g., parquet/ndjson), and any hands-on confirmation of import/export workflows.
